attributes.name: numchans
attributes.digest: Number of Channels
attributes.description: The number of channels to compute statistics for. The default of -1 indicates to compute statistics through the last channel in thebuffer.

attributes.name: numderivs
attributes.digest: Number of Derivatives
attributes.description: The number of derivatives of the original time-series to compute statistics on. The default of 0 will compute statistics on no derivatives, only the original time-series itself. Setting this parameter > 0 (maximum of 2) will return the same seven statistics computed on consecutive derivatives of the channel's time-series. (= 1 will return the channel's statistics and the statistics of the first derivative,= 2 will return the channel's statistics and the statistics of the first and second derivatives.) The derivative statistics are useful to describe the rate of change of the time series. Constraints Minimum: Maximum:

attributes.name: numframes
attributes.digest: Number of Frames
attributes.description: The number of frames to use in the statistical analysis. The default of -1 indicates to use all the frames fromthrough the end of thebuffer.

attributes.name: outlierscutoff
attributes.digest: Outliers Cutoff
attributes.description: A ratio of the inter quantile range (IQR) that defines a range from the median, outside of which data will be considered an outlier and not used to compute the statistical summary. For each frame, if a single value in any channel of that frame is considered an outlier (when compared to the rest of the values in its channel), the whole frame (on all channels) will not be used for statistical calculations. The default of -1 bypasses this function, keeping all frames in the statistical measurements. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: weights
attributes.digest: Weights Buffer
attributes.description: A buffer to provide relative weighting of each frame in thebuffer when computing the statistics. Not providing abuffer will cause all the frames to be considered equally. This may be useful for weighting certain descriptors by the value of other descriptors (such as the loudness or pitch confidence of the sound). The provided buffer has to satisfy all of the following conditions: a single-channel exactly the same amount of frames as all values must be positive (anything lower than 0 will be rejected)

messages.name: bang
messages.description: A bang will commence processing on object given its current settings, unless it is already busy. In that case, the behaviour depends on the value of theattribute.

messages.name: cancel
messages.description: When processing in non-blocking mode, this will cancel the job underway, without updating destination buffers.

messages.name: reset
messages.digest: Return the object to its original state
messages.description: Callingwill change parameter values back to those the object waswith, i.e. any attribute values set in the box will be retained
